methodology
methodology · 4 records
  1. Quarter-end historical facts use original period/filing evidence; Q4 is annual less nine-month YTD when no standalone Q4 XBRL fact exists.
  2. Sum of stated segment ranges is a derived consolidated range. Original and revised versions are kept distinct.
  3. Positive revenue error is actual above midpoint. Approximate growth comments are not strict confidence intervals.
  4. No arbitrary credibility multiplier is applied. Guidance beats may reflect conservative targets and capacity/revenue-recognition timing, not unbiased forecasting.

claims Policy
Debt carrying value excludes lease liabilities. Do not deduct undiscounted commitments as if already recognized debt. Long-term investment carrying value is not guaranteed realizable value; any add-on must exclude operating cash flows already modeled. SBC remains an expense and dilution/cash replacement must be reconciled.

status
Disputed transfer-pricing assessment; company believes existing tax contingency allowances adequate; resolution/timing and incremental unreserved exposure uncertain.
model Treatment
Stress separately; do not deduct full demand as certain incremental debt or ignore; reconcile existing reserves to avoid duplicate deduction.
implementation Gates
implementation Gates · 5 records
  1. No default otherClaims=0 or otherAssets=0 may be interpreted as verified absence.
  2. Confirm current cash/debt/shares bridge and consistently classify leases before per-share publication.
  3. Keep SBC as operating cost; reconcile issued shares/outstanding awards and any repurchase assumption without double counting.
  4. A single immediate linear fade cannot represent early annual schedule, cost squeeze and front-loaded investment; use richer model or disclose approximation.
  5. Terminal ROIC and incremental sales/capital must reconcile; no sudden free terminal growth.
interpretation
WACC and terminal parameters are analyst estimates; strong guidance track records do not receive a mechanical credibility uplift.
rationale
rationale · 6 fields
growth
Base18/17/15/13/11% balances FY26+17.8%, next-quarter16–17% total guide, Azure45% CC guide and broad RPO growth excluding OpenAI25%. It does not extrapolate totalRPO84% or Azure43% to the consolidated company. Bull20-year scale is deliberately demanding and must be tested against customer IT spending.
margin
FY27 guide down<1pp anchors46% first-year versus46.78% FY26. Fade toward43% prices in lower-margin infrastructure/consumption mix and faster economic obsolescence; bull46% needs applications and efficiency offset; bear36% tests pricing/utilization failures.
capital
Base0.45x first-year incremental sales/capital charges approximately$133bn reinvestment, then improves. FY26 cash+finance-lease additions less cash-flow D&A/other already imply~0.49x before working capital. Long-run0.85x requires substantial utilization and efficiency gains. CY2026 capex175bn is classification-sensitive, not an investment cut.
tax
22% normalized cash-tax estimate above FY27 quarterly20% guide, with investment gains/deferred taxes excluded from operating earnings logic.
terminal
Base16% marginal ROIC,15-year maturity;20-year bull22% ROIC requires durable software/application capture. Bear11% at10years leaves little spread over10.5% WACC. Final capital ratio is explicitly reconciled to terminal ROIC.
bridge
Lease liabilities66.594bn finance and21.925bn operating plus329.1bn uncommenced commitments require economic cash-flow treatment; do not capitalize all and also charge all lease rent. Review36.348bn investments separately; do not project fair-value gains into EBIT.
invalidators
invalidators · 6 records
  1. Azure growth slows materially despite new capacity becoming available, weakening scarcity/utilization thesis
  2. RPO conversion slows, cancellation/credit terms worsen or frontier-lab concentration rises
  3. Reported capex declines because of reclassification while cash lease burden/prepayments continue rising
  4. Cloud margin and cash generation fall beyond FY27 outlook without monetization improvement
  5. Copilot paid usage rises faster than usage pricing or customer retention fails to support economic cost
  6. Hardware replacement needs or impairment undermine six-year server accounting life and long-lived infrastructure utilization

bounded Model Gaps
bounded Model Gaps · 4 records
  1. Valuation-date stub and post-anchor cash/claims/share roll-forward not integrated; this is a forecast-origin operating EV, not October 17 equity value.
  2. No probability weighting or share-price calibration. Source forecast assumptions are judgments, not reported facts.
  3. Enterprise-to-equity bridge is not computed here; consult the company-specific claim register for resolved evidence, assumptions and remaining uncertainties. Zero is not evidence of absence.
  4. Net investment is an analytical sales-to-capital schedule. Full gross capex, maintenance, D&A, leases and WC cash bridge is not supplied for every year.

rationale
rationale · 10 fields
growth
18% begins near FY2026 reported growth. Azure and recurring enterprise subscriptions support the starting rate, which then fades to 2.5% as the revenue base expands.
target Margin
42% is below FY2026 operating margin of 46.8%. Recurring software remains profitable, but AI depreciation, inference costs and competition constrain permanent peak-margin extrapolation.
tax
22% allows a higher normalized burden than FY2026 accounting tax of 19.4%; it does not extend discrete investment-related tax effects indefinitely.
sales Capital
0.6x means $1.67 of incremental net capital per extra $1 of revenue. FY2026 cash capex was $115.9bn; AI capacity makes an old asset-light software ratio inappropriate. It remains a normalized net-reinvestment assumption, not gross capex guidance.
terminal ROIC
16% assumes a persistent distribution and switching-cost advantage while fading returns as cloud infrastructure becomes a larger part of the business.
wacc
9.5% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 1.0, 5% target debt and a 0.5-point debt spread reflect diversified recurring revenue and modest financing risk, with AI-demand uncertainty still present.
terminal Growth
2.5% nominal USD is a mature-state assumption with limited real expansion, well below the high-growth starting rate and the discount rate; it is not a company forecast.
years
10 years is the common model horizon so company economics can be compared; rates and margins fade over this period. The number is a modeling convention, not a source fact.
other Claims
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not evidence that no additional claims exist. Finance-lease obligations and non-operating investments are material. Lease capitalization must be reconciled with operating profit and reinvestment, not deducted a second time mechanically.
other Assets
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not a statement that all non-operating assets are absent or worthless. Review assets not already included in snapshot cash and avoid double counting.
